# Kapit — Financial data API for AI agents
# https://kapit.dev

Kapit is a unified financial data REST API designed natively for AI agents.
One API key. One base URL. One consistent response envelope. Provider-normalized schemas.

## Base URL
https://api.kapit.dev

## Authentication
Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>
API keys are prefixed: kap_test_... (sandbox) or kap_live_... (production)

## Endpoints

### Stocks
GET /v1/stocks/quotes/{symbol}
- Returns real-time stock quote data
- Primary provider: FMP. Fallback: Twelve Data
- symbol: ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, TSLA)

### Crypto
GET /v1/crypto/prices/{symbol}
- Returns cryptocurrency price data
- Provider: CoinGecko
- symbol: CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana) — NOT ticker

### Prediction Markets
GET /v1/polymarket/markets/{market_id}
- Returns Polymarket prediction market data
- market_id: numeric ID or slug (e.g. bitcoin-all-time-high-by-september-30-2026)

### Usage
GET /v1/usage
- Returns your API key usage, quota, and tier

## Response envelope
Every endpoint returns KapitResponse[T]:
{
  "data": { ...asset-specific payload... },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "req_...",
    "source": { "provider": "fmp", "primary_provider": "fmp", "fallback_used": false },
    "freshness": { "as_of": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "cache_ttl_seconds": 60 },
    "usage": { "cache": false },
    "rate_limit": { "limit": 1000, "remaining": 987, "reset_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z" }
  }
}

## Error envelope
Every error returns KapitErrorResponse:
{
  "error": {
    "code": "symbol_not_found",
    "message": "The requested symbol was not found.",
    "doc_url": "https://kapit.dev/docs/errors/symbol_not_found",
    "is_retriable": false,
    "retry_after_seconds": null,
    "alternative_action": "Check the symbol format and try again.",
    "recovery": { "action": "fix_params", "param": "symbol" }
  },
  "meta": { "request_id": "req_..." }
}

## Agent usage notes
- Inspect meta.source.provider to know which data provider served the response
- Inspect meta.freshness.as_of to know data freshness
- Inspect meta.rate_limit.remaining to manage quota
- Follow error.recovery.action for structured error recovery
- Use /openapi.json for the full OpenAPI 3.1 spec
- Crypto symbols are CoinGecko IDs (bitcoin) not tickers (BTC)

## Get an API key
https://kapit.dev/signup
